dedupe_keys.name: irrmap large scale dataset for irrigation method mapping western united states 2013 2023

description: A machine-learning-ready dataset for mapping how fields are irrigated. The arXiv paper (May 2025) says IrrMap has 1.1 million image patches from Landsat and Sentinel with crop type, land use and vegetation indices, covering 1,687,899 farms and 14,117,330 acres in several western US states from 2013 to 2023, in standardised 224 by 224 GeoTIFF patches labelled by irrigation method, and that the data, derived datasets, benchmark models and code are released free on GitHub and Hugging Face. Coverage is several western US states. Licence: not stated for the dataset (the repository README has an empty licence section); the describing arXiv preprint is CC-BY-4; reuse terms therefore remain unverified.0. For simulation it shows which farms use flood, sprinkler or drip irrigation, which changes water and energy demand and drought vulnerability. A related catalogue record is the GMIE global maximum irrigation extent.
